The 2024 BMW 3 Series 320i M Sport combines refined engineering with the distinctive styling associated with the M Sport trim. This model is powered by a 2.0 litre petrol engine that meets Euro 6 emission standards, ensuring it aligns with current environmental regulations. As a recent model, it offers the latest in automotive design and performance standards expected from the BMW brand.

This vehicle is designed to offer practical benefits alongside its performance capabilities, making it a sensible choice for daily driving. It features a large boot space, providing ample room for luggage or shopping, which adds a layer of convenience often sought after in this class of car. Furthermore, the inclusion of the Parking Assistant, which incorporates front and rear sensors along with a rear camera, simplifies manoeuvring in tight spaces. The vehicle also benefits from a low insurance group rating, which helps to manage the ongoing costs of ownership compared to other similar models.
